message.reasoning:
The user asks "昨晚大富翁遊戲是誰贏了?" which translates from Chinese as "Who won last night's Monopoly (big tycoon) game?" They want information about who won last night’s Monopoly game.

We have no context about what happened last night; we don't know if there's data available. We might need to ask clarifying question? But maybe they expect us to answer with some guess? There's no known knowledge base. So best approach: respond politely asking for more details like where/when it was played, participants etc., because I cannot determine winner without info. Also mention privacy concerns. Let's do so.
